description:
In DeviationRunner::run_chain (pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:724-735), apply_deviations is called with a single cert but processes raw findings that include findings from ALL certs (from run_cert for that iteration). Actually no — it's called once per cert (per-loop), so each cert's findings are passed to apply_deviations with that cert. This looks correct on re-read. Demote.

Actually: the code calls runner.run_cert(cert, kind, i, now_unix) and then self.apply_deviations(raw, cert, now_unix) in the same loop iteration, so cert is the same in both calls. The scope check in find_deviation also uses that same cert. This is correct.

Withdrawal: no finding here.
title: P0: DeviationRunner.run_chain applies single cert deviation to all certs in chain
